    FROM Customer

ranked AS (

           amount,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY visited_on) AS rn,
           SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sum_7,

sql-83:
WITH season_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.category,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sale_date) IN (12, 1, 2) THEN 'Winter'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sale_date) IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 'Spring'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sale_date) IN (6, 7, 8) THEN 'Summer'
            ELSE 'Fall'
        END AS season,
        s.quantity,
        s.price
    FROM sales s
    JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        category,
        SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(quantity * price) AS total_revenue
    FROM season_sales
    GROUP BY season, category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        category,
        total_quantity,
        total_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY season 
            ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, total_revenue DESC, category ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM aggregated
)
SELECT season, category, total_quantity, total_revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY 
    CASE season
        WHEN 'Winter' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Spring' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Summer' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Fall' THEN 4
    END ASC;

SELECT 
  customer_id,
  total_orders,
  ROUND(peak_hour_percentage, 2) AS peak_hour_percentage,
  ROUND(average_rating, 2) AS average_rating
FROM (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', order_timestamp) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 11 AND 13 
                      OR CAST(strftime('%H', order_timestamp) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 18 AND 20 
                     THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS peak_hour_percentage,
    AVG(order_rating) AS average_rating,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_rating IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rated_orders
  FROM restaurant_orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
) AS stats
WHERE total_orders >= 3
  AND peak_hour_percentage >= 60
  AND 100.0 * rated_orders / total_orders >= 50
  AND average_rating >= 4.0
ORDER BY average_rating DESC, customer_id DESC;

WITH ranked_events AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM subscription_events
),
user_history AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           MAX(monthly_amount) AS max_historical_amount,
           DATEDIFF(day, MIN(event_date), MAX(event_date)) AS days_as_subscriber
    FROM subscription_events
    GROUP BY user_id
),
downgrade_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_id
    FROM subscription_events
    WHERE event_type = 'downgrade'
)
SELECT r.user_id,
       r.plan_name AS current_plan,
       r.monthly_amount AS current_monthly_amount,
       h.max_historical_amount,
       h.days_as_subscriber
FROM ranked_events r
JOIN user_history h ON r.user_id = h.user_id
JOIN downgrade_users d ON r.user_id = d.user_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
  AND r.event_type != 'cancel'
  AND r.monthly_amount < 0.5 * h.max_historical_amount
  AND h.days_as_subscriber >= 60
ORDER BY h.days_as_subscriber DESC, r.user_id ASC;

SELECT 
    s.student_id,
    s.subject,
    s_first.score AS first_score,
    s_last.score AS last_score,
    s_last.score - s_first.score AS improvement
FROM 
    (SELECT student_id, subject, MIN(exam_date) AS first_date, MAX(exam_date) AS last_date
     FROM Scores
     GROUP BY student_id, subject
     HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS sub
JOIN Scores AS s_first
    ON sub.student_id = s_first.student_id
    AND sub.subject = s_first.subject
    AND sub.first_date = s_first.exam_date
JOIN Scores AS s_last
    ON sub.student_id = s_last.student_id
    AND sub.subject = s_last.subject
    AND sub.last_date = s_last.exam_date
WHERE s_last.score > s_first.score
ORDER BY s.student_id ASC, s.subject ASC;

WITH first_positive AS (
    SELECT patient_id, MIN(test_date) AS first_positive_date
    FROM covid_tests
    WHERE result = 'Positive'
    GROUP BY patient_id
),
first_negative_after AS (
    SELECT ct.patient_id, MIN(ct.test_date) AS first_negative_date
    FROM covid_tests ct
    JOIN first_positive fp ON ct.patient_id = fp.patient_id
    WHERE ct.result = 'Negative'
      AND ct.test_date > fp.first_positive_date
    GROUP BY ct.patient_id
)
SELECT p.patient_id, p.patient_name, p.age,
       DATEDIFF(fn.first_negative_date, fp.first_positive_date) AS recovery_time
FROM patients p
JOIN first_positive fp ON p.patient_id = fp.patient_id
JOIN first_negative_after fn ON p.patient_id = fn.patient_id
ORDER BY recovery_time ASC, p.patient_name ASC;

SELECT 
    d.driver_id,
    d.driver_name,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.trip_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 
                   THEN t.distance_km / NULLIF(t.fuel_consumed, 0) 
              END), 2) AS first_half_avg,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.trip_date) BETWEEN 7 AND 12 
                   THEN t.distance_km / NULLIF(t.fuel_consumed, 0) 
              END), 2) AS second_half_avg,
    ROUND(
        AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.trip_date) BETWEEN 7 AND 12 
                 THEN t.distance_km / NULLIF(t.fuel_consumed, 0) 
            END) -
        AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.trip_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 
                 THEN t.distance_km / NULLIF(t.fuel_consumed, 0) 
            END)
    , 2) AS efficiency_improvement
FROM drivers d
JOIN trips t ON d.driver_id = t.driver_id
GROUP BY d.driver_id, d.driver_name
HAVING 
    AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.trip_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 
             THEN t.distance_km / NULLIF(t.fuel_consumed, 0) 
        END) IS NOT NULL
    AND 
    AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.trip_date) BETWEEN 7 AND 12 
             THEN t.distance_km / NULLIF(t.fuel_consumed, 0) 
        END) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY efficiency_improvement DESC, d.driver_name ASC;

SELECT 
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    s.location,
    most_exp.product_name AS most_exp_product,
    cheapest.product_name AS cheapest_product,
    ROUND(cheapest.quantity * 1.0 / most_exp.quantity, 2) AS imbalance_ratio
FROM stores s
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        store_id, 
        product_name, 
        quantity, 
        price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY price DESC) AS rn_desc
    FROM inventory
) most_exp ON s.store_id = most_exp.store_id AND most_exp.rn_desc = 1
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        store_id, 
        product_name, 
        quantity, 
        price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY price ASC) AS rn_asc
    FROM inventory
) cheapest ON s.store_id = cheapest.store_id AND cheapest.rn_asc = 1
WHERE 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_name) FROM inventory i WHERE i.store_id = s.store_id) >= 3
    AND most_exp.quantity < cheapest.quantity
ORDER BY imbalance_ratio DESC, s.store_name ASC;
